headline: Passage Rages On as Expanse Erupts Anew
war_summary: Since the midday edition the center of action has shifted to the Weathered Expanse and Callahan's Passage, both filing returns within minutes of the wire. The Expanse reports nine changes in two hours to 14:58 for forty-five on the day, standing at one Warden, five Colonial and three unheld about Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, with twenty-four-hour losses of 5,879 Colonial and 9,571 Warden and both casualty rates accelerating on the two-hour window. The Passage adds eight changes in two hours to 15:16 for twenty-eight on the day, now nine Warden and one unheld about Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage, with losses of 10,074 and 11,273. Palantine Berm, the Shelf, the Nevish Line and Mooring County have gone quiet in the last two hours, last heard at 11:55, 13:16, 09:47 and 13:16 respectively, though Berm counts thirty-three changes on the day all Warden-held, the Line twenty-eight at six Warden and two Colonial, the Shelf nineteen at one Warden and eight Colonial about Briar, and Mooring six all Warden-held at The Wind Hills amid still-climbing casualty rates.
